caption: The drawing depicts a single tool with two main components: a handle and a metal blade. The handle is elongated, cylindrical, and slightly tapered at both ends, colored in light brown with wood grain texture, indicating that it is made of wood. The blade is attached to one end of the handle and is metallic, colored in shades of gray and dark steel blue with some areas of subtle brownish tint, suggesting aged or worn metal. The metal blade has an L-shaped bend—protruding out straight from the handle, then making a sharp right-angle bend before extending out to form a flattened, slightly curved rectangular end. The background is plain and light tan or off-white with a few minor speckles, providing clear contrast to the object, which is centered horizontally in the composition. There are no other objects or decorative elements in the image.
title: Plaster Iron
